❯ Without using any tools, write a numbered list of 14 short tips for better sleep, one per line, then end by asking me
  which one I want to try first?

⏺ 1. Keep a consistent wake-up time, even on weekends.
  2. Go to bed when you feel sleepy, not when you think you should.
  3. Keep your bedroom cool, around 65–68°F (18–20°C).
  4. Make the room dark, using blackout curtains or an eye mask.
  5. Keep it quiet, or use earplugs or white noise.
  6. Limit caffeine after noon.
  7. Avoid alcohol close to bedtime, since it fragments sleep.
  8. Stop heavy meals about two to three hours before bed.
  9. Dim the lights and reduce screen use in the last hour.
  10. Get bright daylight outside in the morning.
  11. Exercise regularly, but finish vigorous workouts a few hours before bed.
  12. Use the bed only for sleep and intimacy, not for work or scrolling.
  13. If you can't fall asleep after about 20 minutes, get up and do something calm in dim light.
  14. Write down worries before bed so they're less likely to keep you awake.

  Which one do you want to try first?
